input.summary: Test the Catwalk ramp and spell P-H-A-N-T-O-M. Repeat the lit ramp for Unlimited Millions. On the configured last ball, make two consecutive ramps for Double Score. Use Organ Multiball when the two-stage relock is reliable.

quickInfo.name: Unlimited Millions
quickInfo.summary: Complete P-H-A-N-T-O-M to light the Catwalk for repeatable 1,000,000-point shots.

quickInfo.name: Organ Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Lock and release one ball, relock both balls in the Organ, then plunge into three-ball jackpot play.

quickInfo.name: Catwalk during Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Catwalk shots can complete P-H-A-N-T-O-M and start Unlimited Millions during Organ Multiball. On the configured final ball, two consecutive Catwalk ramps can also start Double Score while Multiball is running.

quickInfo.name: Raise Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: Complete the top lanes to start a timed switch-value build for the progressive Organ Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Double Score
quickInfo.summary: On the configured last ball, two quick left ramps start full-playfield 2x scoring.

quickInfo.name: Magic Mirror
quickInfo.summary: Mirror shots advance Bonus X to 5x, then light Extra Ball and Hold Bonus on later shots.

quickInfo.name: Ramp features during Multiball
quickInfo.summary: P-H-A-N-T-O-M letters and Unlimited Millions can be completed during Multiball. On the configured last ball, the two-ramp Double Score sequence can also be started while Multiball is running.

steps.text: Test the left ramp and its return on the first controlled ball. Stop the route after one center-feed reject.
Shoot lit P-H-A-N-T-O-M letters and use safe ramp repeats to complete the word.
Complete P-H-A-N-T-O-M, then repeat the lit Catwalk ramp for Unlimited Millions.
modeNotes: Unlimited Millions: Each lit Catwalk shot scores 1,000,000.

steps.text: On the configured final ball, shoot the left ramp once to start the Double Score hurry-up and again before it expires.
modeNotes: Double Score: The second quick ramp starts full-playfield 2x scoring for its displayed timer.

steps.text: If the Organ lock path is safe, open the Organ with the skill shot or three Organ targets and lock the first ball.
Plunge the served ball. A non-top switch releases the lock and starts Two-Ball Play.
modeNotes: Two-Ball Play: Put both balls into the Organ within about ten seconds to prepare Three-Ball Play.

steps.text: Relock both balls in the Organ. Plunge the served ball and make a non-top switch to release them into Three-Ball Play.
Hit an Organ target to open the collect for about five to seven seconds. Shoot inside the Organ for Jackpot.
modeNotes: Organ Multiball: The progressive Jackpot starts at 100,000, can reach 2,000,000, and can be collected once per multiball.

steps.text: If one ball is already controlled during Organ Multiball, use the other for controlled Magic Mirror hits to advance Bonus X, then return to the Organ Jackpot sequence.
Use the short grace period after one ball remains for a lit Organ Jackpot, then resume the ramp route.

fallback.title: Recovery: Unlimited Millions ramp loop
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this when the Organ relock timing or target returns are unsafe.

steps.text: Complete P-H-A-N-T-O-M to light Unlimited Millions.
Shoot the lit Catwalk for Unlimited Millions.
Repeat the Catwalk while its return remains controlled.
Stop after a reject or an uncontrolled return.
On the configured last ball, convert two quick ramps into Double Score.

alternatives.title: Position play: Raise Jackpot
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this higher-ceiling route: use this before Organ Multiball when top-lane feeds are safe.

steps.text: Complete the top lanes to start the 20-second Raise Jackpot timer.
Score switches for 1,000 per switch.
Repeat the lanes to reset the timer and raise the switch value through 5,000.
Start Organ Multiball and collect the built progressive Jackpot.

buildsToward.title: Unlimited Millions and maximum Organ Jackpot

steps.text: Complete P-H-A-N-T-O-M and repeat Unlimited Millions.
Use Raise Jackpot to build the progressive value.
Start Organ Multiball and collect its single Jackpot.
Use Double Score on the configured final ball.
Phantom of the Opera has no separate mini-wizard or wizard mode.

playfieldReferences.label: Left ramp
playfieldReferences.description: The ramp used for Unlimited Millions and multiball scoring.

playfieldReferences.label: Organ lock
playfieldReferences.description: The center mechanism used to lock balls and start multiball.

playfieldReferences.label: Phantom shot
playfieldReferences.description: The central face shot used by major feature progress.

input.simpleOverview: In Phantom of the Opera, spelling P-H-A-N-T-O-M lights the Catwalk ramp for repeatable Unlimited Millions. Use the Organ route only when its lock, relock, and return are controlled.
